summary: Specifies EAP-SAKE, an Extensible Authentication Protocol method for authentication and key establishment using a shared secret. It is published to document an IANA EAP type assignment for a vendor's method. This memo is informational.

eli5.summary: Two sides who share a secret use EAP-SAKE to check each other and make fresh keys for talking. This note exists so the method's name and number are officially written down.

questions: eap method shared secret key establishment
